rules.title: Filler opening
rules.pattern: \b(?:it is important to note that|it should be noted that|the purpose of this (?:document|section) is to)\b
rules.message: The opening delays the useful information.
rules.suggestion: State the useful information directly; preserve any qualification.
rules.example: It is important to note that backups expire after 30 days.

rules.title: Promotional cluster
rules.message: Several promotional terms replace a concrete explanation.
rules.suggestion: Describe supported behavior. Keep technical uses of these words.

rules.title: Staged contrast
rules.message: Check whether both sides of this contrast add information.
rules.suggestion: Keep real corrections and distinctions; remove only rhetorical staging.
rules.example: This is not just a timer; it also records laps.

rules.title: Staged question
rules.message: The question may delay an answer the reader needs.
rules.suggestion: State the answer directly unless the question serves the genre.
rules.example: The result? The queue clears in ten seconds.
rules.counterexample: The queue clears in ten seconds.

rules.title: Significance inflation
rules.message: Check whether the claim of importance adds evidence.
rules.suggestion: Keep the fact and avoid adding unsupported significance.
rules.example: At its core, the app records laps.

rules.title: Repeated uncertainty
rules.message: Two qualifiers may express the same uncertainty.
rules.suggestion: Keep the uncertainty: could potentially reduce becomes could reduce, never reduces.
rules.example: The patch could potentially reduce latency.

rules.title: Stock audience opening
rules.message: Check whether the audience opening helps this reader.
rules.suggestion: Keep meaningful audience scope; do not invent a target audience.
rules.example: Whether you are a beginner or an expert, you can export CSV.

rules.title: Trailing benefit claim
rules.message: Check that the trailing benefit follows from the stated behavior.
rules.suggestion: Preserve supported causality and uncertainty; flag unsupported guarantees.
rules.example: The cache refreshes, ensuring fresh reads.

rules.title: Possible passive voice
rules.message: An active subject may clarify who acts.
rules.suggestion: Use active voice only when clearer; retain passive voice when the actor is irrelevant.
rules.example: The file is checked by the server.

rules.title: Formal transition
rules.message: Check whether this transition helps the connection.
rules.suggestion: Retain useful transitions and summaries; simplify only unnecessary ceremony.

rules.title: Repeated em dashes
rules.message: Several dashes may obscure the relationship between clauses.
rules.suggestion: Read the paragraph for flow. Preserve intentional punctuation and voice.

rules.title: Solo author voice
rules.message: Check whether this refers to the solo author or a real group.
rules.suggestion: Use I for the solo author only; preserve team, inclusive, and quoted language.

rules.title: Specific model terminology
rules.message: Use the model name or language model when accurate.
rules.suggestion: Apply the project terminology policy; keep names, quotations, and disclosures accurate.

rules.title: Em dash in house style
rules.message: House style avoids em dashes in public copy.
rules.suggestion: Use a period, comma, colon, or parentheses. Keep dashes in quotations and names.

rules.title: British spelling
rules.suggestion: Use the American spelling. Keep quotations, proper names, and code identifiers.
rules.example: Pick a colour for the theme.
rules.counterexample: Pick a color for the theme.

rules.title: All-caps label
rules.suggestion: Use sentence case. Keep acronyms in capitals.

rules.title: Middle-dot meta string
rules.message: House style avoids middle-dot meta strings.
rules.suggestion: Keep the one detail the reader needs, or write a short sentence.

rules.title: Superlative claim
rules.message: House style replaces superlatives with facts.
rules.suggestion: State the measured behavior instead, such as a time, size, or supported case.

rules.title: Commercial model comparison
rules.message: House style avoids comparisons with commercial models.
rules.suggestion: Describe what this tool does and its measured limits on its own terms.
rules.counterexample: It runs offline on a laptop.
